node.statement: Apply lem-compcb-corner-algebra to the nonvanishing t-projection R in the extended t-C*-algebra (so delta+epsilon=2t): for 2t<=e_ca, A_R=S^A_R with compressed product a dot_R b=Co^A_R(ab), inherited dagger, and compressed unit is an extended 2*C_ca*t-C*-algebra. By lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities, Co_R is idempotent and dagger-preserving on the diagonal; since P,Q are Hermitian, P^R=Co_R(P) and Q^R=Co_R(Q) are Hermitian elements of A_R.
